data.title: Blush Fleur Bridal
data.product_type: Hand embroidered shades of blush  floral motifs adorned with chunky work on blush tulle. The perfect fit for the bride who wants to add touch of royalty to her big day. Paired up with red tulle dupatta floral placements on duptta and jewelled embelished sweetheart neckline corset under the jacket. The flared A-line jacket has a large keyhole at the back, highlighted by a chunky worked edging tied up with tassels.

data.title: The Maharani Bridal
data.product_type: The Maharani Bridal is one of a kind heirloom bridal from Faraz Manan 'Rouge' collection . Crafted with traditional zardozi and indegeneous marori work along with swarovskis. Combining the richness of intricate detailing and traditional craftsmanship.

data.title: The Majesty Bridal
data.product_type: The majesty bridal is a rich traditional ensemble. It's an elaborate lehnga put together through variation of panels with explicit details and an extended blush border too, that has hints of red resham and zardozi work. Adorned with blush chikan kari hand emboirdered chaadar accented with gold and silver sequins, rich zardozi borders on all four sides.

data.title: The Kohinoor Bridal
data.product_type: Kohinoor Bridal is a classic red Faraz Manan bridal. This ensemble is exquisitely hand embroidered with intricate detailing of zardozi, marori and mukaish work along with meticulous details of gold resham thread. paired up with blush dhaka adding a rich blend of violet detailing fully worked with precise symetrical motifs.
